activity_summary: You ate before church. The loaf was a penny and a finger and a half short. Alse had four willow wands for three marks, and Gib stayed on the shut chronicle. You said the glass was not bought, and that you would not write it into the morning's sheet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, left the cat, and said the glass was not bought.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set the loaf against the notch, named the three marks, and sent him to wash.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought four peeled wands and would not lift the cat.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said he would learn three marks and not invent a fourth.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Sat on the shut chronicle and did not move.

entities.name: the penny loaf

facets.activity: Ate the short loaf before church

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Eat before you are holy. The loaf is a finger and a half short of the notch, and the price is a penny.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is not bought. John said four shillings, and that he would break one every time.
